runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat off pace 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back after the start, settled at the back 7-8Ls off the pace, still plenty to do 400M, finished off well making good progress to take 4th close home
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步後留居後列，落後領放馬七至八個馬位。四百米處仍落後甚多。衝刺良佳，追前甚多，接近終點時取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, held up top of the Straight, never impress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路初受困，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, keen to halfway, angled wide for a run early in home straight, stayed on late but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程前搶口。直路早段移出外疊取位。末段保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled within 2L of pace in 3rd on the rail, saved ground turning in for home but unable to sustain effort shortly upon straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，但入直路後不久無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W1W1W) Won early battle for lead and set good pace, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W1W1W) 早段取得領先，以快步速領放。一百五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W2W1W1W) Led, under pressure and headed 450m out, weakened quickly, eased.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W2W1W1W) 領放。受催策，四百五十米處被超越，迅速轉弱及收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along to chase leaders 550m out, flattened out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-division, hung out on bends, lost position 600m out, soon well held, eased.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎外閃。六百米處失位。瞬即被拋離，收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on the outside early, raced in 2nd after entering the back straight, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。進入對面直路後居第二位。轉入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Waited with towards rear, not best of runs 400m out to 150m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處至一百五十米處之間未能完全望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Tracked leaders, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, taken wider into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。入直路時移出較外疊，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide, a length or so back, moved a bit closer after passing 1200M, 2 wide from 1000M, 1/2L back turning in, peaked 300M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。跑過千二米處後略為追近。自一千米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。三百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W3W3W) Held up in rear, tight for room when headway amongst horses over 100m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W3W3W) 留居後列。一百米處在馬匹之間追前之際受緊迫，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Wide in mid-field, forward move 500m out, unable to sustain, weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。五百米處上前，其後無以為繼，直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Mid-field, headway out wide final bend, chased leaders 200m out, flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。二百米處追趕領先馬匹。末段洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W2W) Raced in last pair, still plenty to do final bend, stayed on into mid-field, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W2W) 居最後兩位之內。直路彎仍落後甚遠。保持走勢，進佔中間位置。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sluggish start and lost ground, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，失地。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W4W) Not the cleanest away and sat near the rear, overracing early stages, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W4W) 出閘欠俐落，居後列。早段搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般及發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Moderately away, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘普通。居中間稍後位置，落後約四個馬位，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start and unbalanced, raced better than midfield but trapped wide early, 2 wide after entering the back straight, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間之前位置，但早段走外疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted across to the tail of the field from gate 13, swung wide for a run at the home straight, rushed home despite laying in.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，切入居尾列。直路上向外移出取位。儘管內閃，但末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Held up in last pair from wide draw, still in rear entering home straight, hung right, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居最後兩位之內。入直路時仍居後列。內閃，無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) In last few after beginning from the widest barrier, jockey reported lost use of iron briefly, improved steadily in back straight to reach midfield 4-wide onto home bend, even wider turning in for home, soon weakened on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 自大外檔出閘後居最後數位之內。騎師報告，他的左腳曾脫出腳踏。對面直路上穩步上前，開始轉直路彎時進佔中間位置，走第四疊。入直路時走更外疊，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W4W) Towards rear, taken wide bend, hung right under pressure, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W4W) 居後列。直路彎移出外疊。在催策下內閃，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Rear of mid-field, short of room bend, headway once clear over 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎空位不足。三百米處望空後隨即上前。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, cleared near 250M, finished off very strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路初未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲亞軍，僅以頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway 400m out, unable to sustain and flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前。未能保持走勢，最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along to race in rear early stages, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，早段在推策下居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, held up last, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on well, crowded closing stages and unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持佳勢，末段受擠迫，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Slowly into stride, in rear, stayed towards rail and headway into mid-field on bend, stayed on under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。保持走內欄。直路彎上前居中間位置。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield, traveled comfortably, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, short of room early in home straight, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速。直路初空位不足。末段走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, switched top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初轉換跑線。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last pair top of home straight, no impression.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居最後兩位，毫無表現。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Hampered at start, waited with in rear, keen early, driven along 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時受阻礙，居後列，留力候上。早段搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Raced close up, effort early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路初發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, slightly weakened passing the 150M, closed off okay (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居前列。跑過一百五十米處時略為轉弱。衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along 500m out to chase leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處受推策，追趕領放馬。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, travelled keenly, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先，搶口。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W5W) Sat towards rear, switched out and pressed on rounding the Turn, stayed on nicely to grab 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W5W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出，受催策。末段保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide in home straight, forced to steady 250m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上受推策，走外疊。二百五十米處被迫收慢。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 200m but lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 3 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made no impression in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近，直路彎落後三個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, switched widest in home straight, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策。直路上移至最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure from 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起受催策。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W2W3W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide after entering the back straight, wider turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W2W3W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced very wide throughout, improved to track pace out wide without cover 1500m out, effort 500m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W3W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，沿途走大外疊。千五米處上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W4W) Began only fairly from a wide draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W4W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W1W2W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, in rear after forced to steady 1500m out, taken widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。千五米處被迫收慢，其後居後列。入直路時移出最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide in 2nd, 1/2L back, same position on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 150M, kept on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，落後半個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, found rail near 400M, kept to inside after straightening and finished off well to take 2nd. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近四百米處時移入內欄。入直路後固守內欄，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the outside, finished off strongly, just beaten in a ding-dong battle.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段衝刺強勁，叮噹馬頭下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped at start, mid division, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及發生碰撞。居中間位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began smartly from the widest draw, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead 400M, peaked and headed approaching 100M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。四百米處取得領先。趨近一百米處時未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced towards rear, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及被觸碰，居後列。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Wide early, across to track leader, pressed leader top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 早段走外疊，切入以跟隨領放馬。直路初追迫領放馬，最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly and switched for clear run 400m out, challenged and every chance in home straight, no extra final 100m, checked close home.
(Sustained a small abrasion to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small abrasion to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，四百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路上展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百米再無餘力，接近終點時勒避。
（右膝輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide, a length or so back, 2 wide from 800M, same margin back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。自八百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, closed off nicely, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sluggish start, rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 600M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。六百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Raced rear, switched out at the Turn, limited response when placed under pressure (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, not enough room early in straight, showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段空位不足，其後對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, driven 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, took the early lead, headed 1250M, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，早段取得領先。一千二百五十米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一個半馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W4W) Towards rear, wide and lost ground final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎走外疊及失地。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W4W5W) Waited with towards rear, headway widest final bend, strong run to lead over 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W4W5W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎上前，走最外疊。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Raced very widest without cover throughout, some headway on bend, lost touch final 300m, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。最後三百米未能跟上對手，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled behind midfield 6Ls back, only battled home final 400M and was safely held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，落後六個馬位。最後四百米僅能勉力而為，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W) Raced wide in rear, improved to track pace out wide without cover 900m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W) 居後列，走外疊。推進以跟隨領放馬，九百米處走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Out with rest, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, peaked 450M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。四百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped fairly and then shortly after was checked, ended up racing near last, had some work to do top of the straight but couldn't quite finish off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，其後不久勒避，居接近包尾位置。直路初落後頗遠，但衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden to hold position middle stages, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。中段在催策下保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, had to check at the early stages, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段須勒避。衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Away ok and sat slightly worse than midfield 3 wide with cover, stayed at the same pace to the line when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘尚可，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段在催策下保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider on bend, effort 350m out, not beaten far.
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。三百五十米處發力。所負不遠。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, no clear run approaching 150M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段追前甚多。趨近一百五十米處時未能望空，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, keen middle stages, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。中段搶口。自四百米處起受催策，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, traveled okay, held up at the straight, finished off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。直路上受困。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W5W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on well but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持佳勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, saved ground, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 950m out, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。九百五十米處移出外疊開始發力。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Settled behind midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, dropped to last place 750m out and soon ridden, passed a few tiring rivals in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。七百五十米處墮居包尾位置，瞬即受催策。直路上超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled well behind from the widest barrier, came under pressure to challenge just inside the 400m saving ground on rail turning in for home, ran on under pressure despite interrupted runs in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居於後。跑過四百米處後在催策下展開挑戰。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。直路上儘管受阻礙，但在催策下上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-3/4L behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W2W) Tracked pace, tight for room amongst horses early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初在馬匹之間受緊迫，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, weakened inside 150M, failed to respond (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放。最後一百五十米轉弱，對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, keen middle stages, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。未能望空直至二百米處。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight of room 150m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時須等待空位出現。一百五十米處空位不足。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, lost ground when wideset into straight, ran about and a difficult ride early in straight, baulked for a run inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走最外疊之際失地。直路初斜跑，難以催策。最後一百米受阻。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居第二位。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Under pressure to hold a position behind midfield, didn't respond turning for home. (Jockey - failed to travel throughout and was not comfortable on the Yielding track. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 受催策以保持中間之後位置。轉入直路時對催策毫無反應。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠順，不適應「黏地」的場地狀況。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled mainly with 2L of pace in 5th or 4th, ran on under pressure to hit the front narrowly 150M out only to be caught final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 大多居第四或第五位，落後領放馬兩個馬位。受催策上前，一百五十米處以短距離領先。僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, obtained clear running until near the 250M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。接近二百五十米處時望空。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, driven 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處受催策。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along 500m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。五百米處受推策。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居後列。略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, traveled ungenerously at the early stages in the box-seat, fail to quicken at the straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段居包廂位置，走勢欠順。直路上未能加速。（ 見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Mid-field, headway wide back straight, chased leaders into home straight, no extra final 75m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置。對面直路上上前，走外疊。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後七十五米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W5W) Sat towards rear, raced wide, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居後列，走外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W4W) In rear, pushed along and wide turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W4W) 居後列。轉入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W3W3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, had trouble finding clear running early in the Straight, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Wide in mid-division, lost place turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時失位，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) From wide draw taken across behind runners, settled near last about 5Ls back, lacked a finishing response in the straight. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，在馬群之後切入，居接近包尾位置，落後約五個馬位。直路上受催策，但衝刺乏力。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back, 3 wide from 500M, a length or so back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。自五百米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先，保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W3W) Wide early, tracked pace, challenged and every chance from 200m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，跟隨領放馬。自二百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leader, pushed along over 400m out, soon lost position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策，其後瞬即失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Wide throughout, raced close up and keen, upsides leaders turning into home straight, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 沿途走外疊，緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。轉入直路時上前追迫領先馬匹。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W3W4W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made some headway from the 500M, gave ground final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起略為追前。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, not much impression made, raced flat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居後列。無甚表現，走勢平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled worse than midfield, raced keenly, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。搶口。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Vied for early lead in a fast run race before dropping back to race ahead of midfield making the turn, came under pressure from 500M and gave ground in the home straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 早段爭奪領先，賽事步速甚快。轉直路彎時墮居中間之前位置。自五百米處起受催策。直路上墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leader, weakened over 200m out.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處轉弱。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
(Jockey dropped whip at 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 居前列，走勢不俗。末段走勢平穩。
（於一百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Raced wide towards rear, pushed along entering home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat outside the lead, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Led on the rail, traveled smoothly, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄領放，走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, faded final 150m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。最後一百五十米力竭，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, showed good speed to lead, ridden along 250m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，展現甚佳前速以領放。二百五十米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W4W) Wide throughout, mid-field, pushed along and lost place over 400m out, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W4W) 沿途居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處受推策，失位。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, closed off well, had every chance (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳，已獲機會盡展所長。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Held up from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear 2 wide, steadied at the early stages, started to make progress rounding Home Turn, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。早段收慢。轉直路彎時開始推進。以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken across from wide draw, raced towards rear, stayed on at the one pace under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後切入內疊，居後列。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Keen towards rear, forward move out wide into mid-field at halfway, headway 300m out, shifted left briefly 200m out, stayed on well, every chance final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 居後列，搶口。半程時上前至中間位置，走外疊。三百米處追前。二百米處一度向外斜跑。末段保持佳勢，最後五十米已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide approaching 500M, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近五百米處時走第二疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, dropped out from wide draw, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，墮後。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W3W3W2W) Settled on pace 3 wide no cover, traveled nicely, made steady progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W3W3W2W) 居前競跑，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。走勢良佳。在鞭策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W2W) Sent forward from high draw and raced wide, tracked leader, improved into share of lead turning into home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。轉入直路時上前，並排領先。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W1W) Mid division, ridden top of home straight, challenged up rail from 200m out, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W1W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰，以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W2W2W) Raced wide, tracked pace, forward move halfway to race outside of leader, unable to stay with that rival, one paced under pressure home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 走外疊，跟隨領放馬。半程時上前居領放馬外側競跑，其後未能跟上該駒。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, pressed on rounding the Turn, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢良佳。轉直路彎時受催策。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden to hold position 600m out, shifted out final bend, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處在催策下保持位置。直路彎向外斜跑。其後未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled towards rear on the rail, little response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。受催策時無甚反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W1W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, held up last, still in last place into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W1W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，留居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W2W1W) Slowly away, held up in last pair, under pressure when short of room 150m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居最後兩位之內。一百五十米處在受催策之際空位不足。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail, commenced move rounding home bend, switched in for a clear run just inside the 200M, kept on steadily without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。轉直路彎時開始上前。跑過二百米處後向內移入以望空。末段保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, good headway middle stages, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。中段追前甚多。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced 2 wide at rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, traveled midfield 2 wide, limited ground made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙。居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Sat last, crowded rounding the Home Turn, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受擠迫。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2WNIL) Retired from the event. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2WNIL) 被收停。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W) With leaders briefly before settling in midfield about 3L off the pace, gained closer on rail to 2L 4th over 600M out but crowded 400M out, unable to make any further impression under pressure after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W) 早段一度與領先馬匹並跑，其後居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。六百米處沿欄追近，居第四位，落後兩個馬位。四百米處受擠迫。入直路後受催策，但未能進一步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move 450M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處開始上前。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W4W) Crowded at start, settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 600m out, short-lived effort turning into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。六百米處開始上前，走外疊。轉入直路時一度發力。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Held up in last pair, laboured response to pressure home straight, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 留居最後兩位之內。直路上在催策下跑來吃力，未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W1W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear, 6 lengths or so back on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列。直路彎落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W1W1W) Sat last, held up rounding the Home Turn, closed off nicely between horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W1W1W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受困。末段在馬匹之間衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled towards the rear, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Slow into stride and sat midfield the fence, saved ground throughout and travelled to the line okay when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段在催策下走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, 9 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約九個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Settled midfield, pushed along wide into home straight, finished off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, traveled okay at midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
Jockey dropped right rein approaching winning post.
runnerrecords.incident_eng: Jockey dropped right rein approaching winning post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般。居中間位置，走內欄，走勢尚可。衝刺良佳。
於趨近終點時騎師右邊韁繩脫手。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 於趨近終點時騎師右邊韁繩脫手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, effort 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢及被碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處發力。其後在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 3 wide with no cover, 2 lengths or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，落後約兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, positioned 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 750M, raced 3 wide, a length or so back on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。七百五十米處開始上前，走第三疊。直路彎落後約一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W4W) In touch with leaders, wide into home straight, strong run to challenge leader 100m out, got on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處向領放馬展開挑戰。最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, showed dash top of the Straight, one pace final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初加速上前。最後一百五十米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百五十米處未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙及與對手互相觸碰，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Held up in last few, went wide for a run into straight but baulked until 250M out, kept on well in closing stages without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 留居最後數位之內。入直路時移出外疊取位，但受困直至二百五十米處。末段保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace until no clear run final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後五個馬位。其後保持同速，最後五十米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden 500m out, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。直路初轉換跑線以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run until final 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled worse than midfield 3 wide, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, kept on well in straight despite shifting out, won by a neck. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。中段輕鬆領放。直路上儘管向外斜跑，但仍保持佳勢，以一馬頸位之先勝出。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Travelled mainly 3-wide with cover in midfield, slightly inconvenienced over 200M out, fought on steadily closing stages without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。二百米處略受妨礙。末段持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled off midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Waited with towards rear, wide final bend, stayed on well and made up several places final 150m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎走外疊。最後一百五十米保持佳勢，追前數位。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear on the rail, 5 lengths back turning in, made steady progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。入直路時落後五個馬位。在鞭策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W4W4W) Held up in rear, taken wide final bend, stayed on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W4W4W) 留居後列。直路彎移出外疊。最後二百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Keen in mid-field, angled wide to make effort 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 中段搶口。三百米處移出外疊以發力，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, driven along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Moderately away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, kept on well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空。保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Settled midfield, gave ground quickly in the Straight (Must BT, See Incident Report).
(Irregular heart rhythm and blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Irregular heart rhythm and blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。直路上迅速墮退。（必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常及氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Badly crowded at start losing ground, tailed-off most of the way, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫及失地。大部分途程居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled wide in rear of midfield, came under pressure rounding home bend, ran on well inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉直路彎時受催策。最後一百五十米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in midfield from moderate start some 3L off the pace, drifted slightly further back onto course proper, renewed effort under pressure inside final 200M, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。跑離分支直路時略為墮後。最後二百米受催策時再度發力，穩步上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, ended up racing at the back of the field, failed to make any real progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居馬群後列。最後四百米無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in mid-field, driven along 600m out, unable to pick up for pressure against rail from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策。自四百米處起沿欄在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From a low draw obtained a midfield position along the inside, couldn't go on passing 300M, weakened to last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自內檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過三百米處時無以為繼。轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, eased when detached 600m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速。六百米處被拋離時收慢。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (5W1W3W) Soon taken back for inside run, gained closer to 10th passing the 900M, commenced move entering home straight obtaining a run inside the 300M, ran on well under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(5W1W3W) 瞬即留後，走內疊。跑過九百米處時追近至第十位。入直路時開始發力。三百米處取位上前，其後在催策下以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Jumped with the field, settled slightly worse than midfield, improved around the field 450M out, stayed on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置。四百五十米處繞過馬群上前。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, good headway final bend, sustained headway to challenge 200m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎追前甚多。持續上前，二百米處展開挑戰，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Soon taken back behind midfield in 9th from a wide barrier, did not find much room in home straight racing in a tight run inside final 100M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居中間之後第九位。直路上空位不足，最後一百米緊迫競跑。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, short of room early in home straight, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初空位不足。未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, briefly hampered 100m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。一百米處一度受阻礙。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Held up in last pair, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 留居最後兩位之內。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W) Mid-field, headway from 400m out, still fourth 100m out, stayed on strongly to edge ahead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起上前，一百米處仍居第四位。保持勁勢，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Mid-field, pushed along 400m out, unable to quicken, stayed on late, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處受推策，未能加速。末段保持走勢，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Held up early, headway into mid-field past halfway, rail run into home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 早段留後。跑過半程後追前至中間位置。入直路時走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W2W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, showed some response early in straight, no clear run near 200M, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W2W) 自第十一檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, ran on nicely early in the Straight, run peak at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初以佳勢追前。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Sat handy on the rail, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。末段走勢強勁，取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Tracked pace, caught wide and didn't settle fully, moved upsides leader top of home straight, seen off by that rival and no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，未能完全穩定走勢。直路初上前追逼領放馬，未能超越，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 100M, kept on very well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Soon took up running with rails run holding narrow advantage to 300M, fought on under pressure until swamped for a placing final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭競跑，走內欄。以短距離領先直至三百米處。在催策下持續力拼，末段被後上馬匹過頭，失去位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Began from the middle draw to make all, taking advantage of the slow early tempo to obtain rails run over 800M out, driven over 2L clear briefly inside the 150M, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 自中檔出閘，一放到底。利用賽事早段慢步速的優勢，八百米處佔取內欄位置。受催策，一百五十米處一度帶離逾兩個馬位。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Chased leader, every chance 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。三百米處一度甚具爭勝機會。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Fast into stride, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘迅速，居前列，走外欄。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, kicked 400m out, headed by winner 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。四百米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Showed good speed to lead, headed by winner halfway out, weakened final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;前速甚快，取得領先。半程時被頭馬超越。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Chased leaders, ridden along 350m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;追趕領先馬匹。三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Tracked leaders, unable to hold position halfway, flattened out final 200m.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;緊隨領先馬匹。半程時未能保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Shared led on the stands' rail, weakened final furlong.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;並排領先，走外欄。最後二百米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat on pace 3 from the stands' rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列，走外欄第四疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Midfield early stages gradually dropping to 11th 850M out, did not find much room on the inside early after straightening but produced good late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，逐漸墮後，八百五十米處居第十一位。入直路後在直路早段走內疊時空位不足，但最後一百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Held up in last pair, stayed on final 200m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 留居最後兩位之內。最後二百米保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well to move into third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以佳勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W3W) Prominent 4-wide before taken one-out-one-back for cover 700M out, came to challenge entering straight but had nothing to give.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W3W) 居前列，走第四疊。七百米處居第二疊第二位以取得遮擋。入直路時上前展開挑戰，但再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W3W5W) Jumped with them, travelling 3 wide no cover throughout, kept on ok considering the circumstances (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W3W5W) 與對手同步躍出，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。在如此形勢下保持尚可走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Out with rest, raced in midfield on the stands' side, weakened from 350M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，靠近外欄競跑。自三百五十米處起轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Exceedance from Star Of Darwin, a daughter of Northern Meteor. Horses by the same sire include Thousand Spirit and Splendor. The fellow was given twelve trials for one second in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second under pressure, beaten by 1L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 28. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「超乎善美」(Exceedance)之後，在港同父馬包括「千杯不醉」及「時時歡笑」等駒，生母出自Northern Meteor。抵港後十二次試閘一次上名。9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一個馬位。最近9月28日出試從化草地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, commenced move out wide 500m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處開始發力，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, weakened quickly over 200m out.
(Jockey dropped whip at 150M.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。二百米處迅速轉弱。
（於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
（心律不正常。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division against far rail, briefly tight for room when under pressure 300m out, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，走外欄。三百米處受催策時一度受緊迫。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) One of the quickest out, tried to stay in touch in midfield but did not travel at any stage of the race, gave ground quickly final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘最快的其中一駒。嘗試保持居於中間位置，但全程走勢欠順。最後四百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, weakened from 500M, eased final furlong, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起轉弱，最後二百米收慢。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped heavily out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生大力碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped and unbalanced shortly after start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久被碰撞，失去平衡。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along 500m out to chase leaders, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Mid-field, switched inside 200m out, stayed on well final 100m and nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處向內移入。最後一百米保持佳勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground from the 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。自三百米處起墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out fast, stranded 3 wide no cover throughout, stuck on gamely despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘迅速，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。儘管多走腳程，但保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled okay on the rail, made good progress inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄，走勢尚可。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W2W) Mid-field, keen mid-race, quickened between horses 150m out, sustained run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。一百五十米處在馬匹之間加速。持續上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 2 wide, carried wider 450M, finished off very strongly, won by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居第三位，走第二疊。四百五十米處被帶出較外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，以短距離之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat toward rear, switched out rounding the Turn, showed some dash over the final 100M, just missed.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。最後一百米略為加速上前，僅敗。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, hard ridden from 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。自三百米處起受力策。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, picked up prominent position under pressure onto first turn, obtained one back rail position in 3rd about 750M out, hung on well for 2nd in straight without ever threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞。開始轉首個彎位時受催策，佔取前列位置。約七百五十米處佔取第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw travelling keenly on heels in early stages, 3-wide in rear rounding home bend swinging widest into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後留後。早段搶口，緊貼他駒後蹄。轉直路彎時居後列，走第三疊。入直路時移出最外疊，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) A bit keen in mid-field, stayed on well final 200m, still gaining on front two at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置，略為搶口。最後二百米保持佳勢。過終點時仍繼續追近首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W3W4W) Raced wide, started well but soon settled back into mid-field, pushed along 400m out, stayed on well final 200m and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W3W4W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處受推策。最後二百米保持佳勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Raced very wide throughout, towards rear and pushed along top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 沿途走大外疊。直路初居後列，受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on but no further impression late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W4W) Away well enough, restrained to race in midfield, had 5Ls to make up on leader 400M, ran on steadily to the line for 4th without troubling the easy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W4W) 出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬五個馬位。末段穩步上前，取得第四名，未能威脅輕鬆勝出的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, lacked pace to challenge.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百米處。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd on rail, gained closer on the inside turning in for home, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時追近，走內疊。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, under pressure to hold position on bend, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎在催策下保持位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Bumped leaving stalls, raced in mid-field, good headway final bend but forced wide, ran on well home straight despite wandering under pressure, led final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置。直路彎以佳勢上前，但被迫走外疊。儘管在催策下走勢欠規矩，但在直路上以佳勢上前。最後一百米領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W4W) Away okay and restrained early to be 3 wide with cover, with the slow pace commenced a long wide surging run around 800m, knuckled down to the task in the final stages to get the job done.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W4W) 出閘尚可，早段受約束，走第三疊，有遮擋。賽事步速緩慢，八百米處開始長距離衝刺，走外疊。末段力拼上前，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W1W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, found rail near 600M, saved ground on turn, finished off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W1W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sat towards rear on the rail, saved ground in the home turn, found no extra under the pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。受催策時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, save grounds in the turn, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat at the rear 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader against stand rail, pushed along over 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬，走外欄。三百米處受推策，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out to maintain position, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以保持位置。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier but soon taken over 2L back travelling 3-wide without cover, similar into straight, fading when checked 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。二百米處勒避之際力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Never far off the pace, in the 6th spot at 400M less than 2L adrift of leader, failed to muster the speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿途距離領放馬不遠。四百米處居第六位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位。未能加速展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, short of room 250m out to 150m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。二百五十米處至一百五十米處之間空位不足。其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Hurried along early stages from gate 12 and positioned one off the outside rail just behind the leading division, boxed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自第十二檔出閘，早段受催策，居領先馬匹稍後位置，走外欄第二疊。以佳勢力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Shifted out at start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)起步時向外斜跑。落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, taken back to race towards rear on the middle track, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, one-paced final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通。留居後列，在跑道中央競跑。中段落後約六個馬位。最後四百米保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders towards centre of course, ridden along 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, crowded and lost balance 600m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover, eased once well held.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫及失去平衡。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, rail position throughout, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。沿途走內欄。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Crowded at start, waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, in midfield early stages before dropping back towards the rear, brought wide into straight but the finishing response was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W5W) 出閘笨拙。早段居中間位置，其後墮居後列。入直路時移出外疊，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start settling just behind midfield in 8th, baulked for a run early in home straight, produced good late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後的第八位。直路早段受困。最後一百米追前頗多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight for room close home, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。接近終點時受緊迫，以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on but no match to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。保持走勢，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind the lead on the rail, kept on fairly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Keen early, settled in mid-field, forward move wide final bend, challenged 150m out, unable to sustain effort.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W4W) 早段搶口，居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。一百五十米處展開挑戰，但無以為繼。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, closed off strongly for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Sat handy 2 wide, raced keenly in the middle stages, kept on well under whip to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。在鞭策下保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Showed speed to take the lead after first bend, kicked 2 lengths clear 200m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 展現前速，首次轉彎後取得領先。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Towards rear, had to switch for clear run 100m out, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列。一百米處須轉換跑線以望空。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Sat 3 wide near the rear, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。毫無表現。
