runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Sat handy, weakened entering the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居前列。進入直路時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, switched for clear run top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路初轉換跑線以望空。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Began well, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Ridden early before gradually settling in 6th within 3L of pace, swung wide for a run into straight, made moderate progress under pressure early on but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段受催策，繼而逐漸居第六位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。入直路時移出外疊取位。直路早段在催策下略為追前，但最後一百米後繼無力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Moved across to the fence shortly after the start from a wide barrier, raced tight in the home straight and unable to be fully ridden out until the last 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘後不久切入內欄。直路上緊迫競跑，未能被全力催策直至最後一百米。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W) Sat near the rear, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Always well behind, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 一直遙居於後。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced at rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, similar position on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Mid-field, well placed on heels of leaders 400m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處居好位，緊隨領先馬匹。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Dropped in from wide draw, short of room briefly 450m out, still in rear top of home straight, limited late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後移入。四百五十米處一度空位不足。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, there to turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made no impression.
(Roarer.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。
（患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Soon dropped to last few racing wide throughout despite ridden along, last rounding home bend, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 瞬即墮居最後數位之內。儘管受催策，但沿途走外疊。轉直路彎時居包尾位置。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Mid-field, forward move and in touch with leaders turning into home straight, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時發力上前，跟隨領先馬匹。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat near the rear 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居接近後列位置，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。趨近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began only fairly, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 350M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般。落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。三百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden 300M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外欄。三百米處受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, ridden along to press leader, struggled to hold position from 300m out, eased when jockey was concerned about its action.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞。受催策，追迫領放馬。自三百米處起難以保持位置。騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Waited with in rear from high draw, stayed on down the outside final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。最後一百五十米沿外疊保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in rear top of home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W3W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail just off the speed, threw his head about in the middle stages, lacked a finish effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。中段搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Settled midfield, held up at the Turn, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受困。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 350M, kept on well in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Towards rear, headway 400m out, stayed on home straight despite tending to hang right, fared best of those coming from off pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 居後列。四百米處追前。儘管在直路上傾向內閃，但保持走勢。在後上馬匹中表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Given a quiet ride from draw 1, dropped back towards the rear along the inside, responded initially in early straight but couldn't sustain run final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後留後，墮居後列，走內疊。直路早段起初對催策交出反應，但末段後勁不繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, outpaced middle stages, ran on well in home straight, short of room final 50m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。中段未能跟上步速。直路上保持佳勢。最後五十米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Tracked leader in a fast run race, fought on in the straight to claim 2nd close home but couldn't get near to the winner. (Jockey : lay out under pressure for the majority of home straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，賽事步速甚快。直路上力拼。接近終點時進佔第二位，但未能追近頭馬。（騎師報告，坐騎在直路上大部分途程在催策下外閃。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Settled just behind midfield on rail, carried backward in slackened tempo to last 750m out, baulked for a run and switched 200M out, quickened well to hit the front 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。七百五十米處步速減慢時墮後至包尾位置。二百米處受困，向外移出。加速良佳，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced at rear on the inside, angled out approaching 350M, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced towards rear on the outside, 7-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Reserved near last 8Ls off the pace, had the task in hand 400M, brought wide into straight, came from a long way back and made solid inroads to finish 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 留居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠。入直路時移出外疊，自遙遙落後的位置上前。末段追前甚多，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear 9-10Ls off the pace in early and middle stages, couldn't go on passing 400M, no extra mid-straight and weakened rapidly. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列，早段及中段落後領放馬九至十個馬位。跑過四百米處時無以為繼。直路中段再無餘力，迅速轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Began slowly losing ground, gradually recovered to just behind midfield on rail, crowded between runners entering home straight, kept on steadily under pressure without quickening inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，失地。逐漸恢復走勢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路時在馬匹之間受擠迫。最後三百米在催策下保持穩勢，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out near 550M, kept on well early in the straight, ran on evenly. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。接近五百五十米處時向外移出。直路早段保持佳勢，末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) From wide draw taken back and reserved near last, over 10Ls off leader middle stages, driven 450M and ran to the line well without troubling first few. Pleasing return after long absence.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居接近包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。四百五十米處受催策。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。久休復出，表現令人滿意。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Gradually settled towards the rear, shifted wide to challenge entering straight, ran on inside final 250M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 逐漸留居後列。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰。最後二百五十米上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Held up in 6th some 8L off the pace, lost position to 7th despite closer to pace 1000 metres out, commenced move approaching home turn 500 metres out and widest into straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 留居第六位，落後領放馬約八個馬位。一千米處追近領放馬，但失位，居第七位。五百米處趨近直路彎時開始發力，入直路時走最外疊。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Caught wide early stages before continuing forward to lead the event, maintained narrow lead in the straight, fought hard but was caught by first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段走外疊，其後持續上前領放。直路上保持以短距離領先。力拼，但末段被頭兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Began awkwardly from wide draw then dropped back to race in last spot over 10Ls off leader, still in clear last top of the straight, ran past well beaten horses only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自最外檔出閘笨拙，其後墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。直路初仍遙居包尾位置。末段僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back to near last on jumping from wide draw, raced keenly in middle stages, 5-6Ls off leader home turn but failed to quicken. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置。中段搶口。直路彎落後領放馬五至六個馬位，但未能加速。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along final bend to chase leaders, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策以追趕領先馬匹。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Chased the pace on the inside, pushed along 500M to keep up the chase on leader, couldn't get any closer final 150M, lost 3rd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬，走內疊。五百米處受推策以持續追趕領放馬。最後一百五十米未能再追近，接近終點時失去第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, angled out 500M, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, held up rounding the Turn, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時受困。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W2W) Slow to begin, sat rear, switched out entering the Straight, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時向外移出。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, mid division, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on strongly and won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。直路早段加速，二百米處領先。末段走勢強勁，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W3W3W) Given a patient ride, settled near last 6Ls off the pace before staying on mildly under top weight. Not able to threaten leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W3W3W) 居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬六個馬位，留力候上。在負頂磅下保持穩勢。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W5W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run final 200m to close on winner but just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W5W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，追近頭馬，但僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W1W1W1W) Settled near last about 6Ls off the pace, kept to inside on straightening, was making good progress when running to the back of the eventual winner near 100M. Could have finished closer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W1W1W1W) 居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬約六個馬位。入直路時固守內疊，追前甚多，但接近一百米處時在頭馬之後未能望空。應可跑得更接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, held up early part of the Straight, made some late ground. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。直路初受困。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W2W1W) Held up last and plenty to do, pushed along 500m out, stuck to inside rail and headway home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W2W1W) 留居包尾位置，落後頗遠。五百米處受推策。直路上固守內欄及追前。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 12 shifted behind runners, settled at the back of the field 8-9Ls off pace in the first half of the race, ran on only fairly through final 300M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘後在馬群之後切入，前半程留居後列，落後領放馬八至九個馬位。最後三百米走勢僅屬一般。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) From draw 1 moved up to race in 5th, always close enough to leaders, shifted out from fence passing 500M, ran on well final 300M to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自第一檔出閘後上前，居第五位，沿途保持落後領先馬匹不遠。跑過五百米處時移離內欄。最後三百米走勢良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, ran on well final 200m, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居包尾位置。最後二百米以佳勢上前。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W2W3W) From draw 1 obtained running in midfield, switched to 2-wide 1100M, driven 400M out, ran on strongly down outside to get up close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W2W3W) 自第一檔出閘後居中間位置。千一米處移至第二疊。四百米處受催策。末段沿外疊以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, followed winner through 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled just off the pace in 3rd on rail, became 4th in a similar position 700M out, commenced move on home bend 500M out stalking the leader into straight, gained upper hand under pressure 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後的第三位，走內欄。七百米處居相若的第四位。五百米處直路彎開始上前，入直路時跟隨領放馬。一百米處在催策下佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, switched in for clear run 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。一百五十米處向內移入以望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Mid division, switched wide 900m out, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。九百米處移出外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能跟上步速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in second half of the field 7Ls off leader, under pressure to keep up rounding home turn, failed to get involved in the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時受催策以跟上。末段未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, showed good dash top of the Straight, run peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路初加速良佳。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on well and passed plenty of fields.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持佳勢，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Away well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, commenced move after passing 550M, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。跑過五百五十米處後開始上前。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, moved smoothly into contention top of home straight, ran on well to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初順勢上前挑戰。以佳勢上前，終點線上險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled nicely, made steady progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間之前位置。走勢良佳，穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Settled down in second half of the field, wide no cover from 700M, widest straightening with some work to do but came with a barnstorming run to get up close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 居後半馬群中。自七百米處起走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走最外疊，仍落後甚遠，但其後展開強勁衝刺，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W3W5W) Switched off to the rear early stages, raced as the back marker in a fast run race before commencing a wide move from 700M, came with a sustained bid to lead nearing 200M, kept on well to win comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W3W5W) 早段留居後列。在快步速下居包尾位置。自七百米處開始在外疊推進。持續上前，接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，輕鬆掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Tightened at start settling in rear on rail and waited with, obtained a clear run near the centre of the track over 150M out, quickened well to snatch victory close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時受緊迫，居後列，走內欄，留力候上。一百五十米處在靠近跑道中央位置望空。末段加速良佳，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W3W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, a bit closer turning in, peaked on run 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時略為追近。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W1W) Held up last, briefly hampered against rail 1400m out, some headway middle stages, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。千四米處沿欄競跑時一度受阻礙。中段略為追前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W1W) Waited with towards rear, challenged up rail from 200m out, ran on well to make up several places.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段走勢良佳，追前數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in second half of the field 8Ls off leader, kept on same pace in the straight and never able to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後半馬群中，落後領放馬八個馬位。直路上保持同速。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled in 5th positioned in second half of the field throughout, kept on same pace in the straight posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。沿途居後半馬群的第五位。直路上保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Never better than mid-division of the small field, commenced move from over 2L back in 5th into straight but unable to make any impression throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 在九駒中從未超越中間位置。入直路時從落後逾兩個馬位的第五位開始發力，但末段全程毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to reach leaders,
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能追上領先馬匹。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Settled in last few from a poor draw and waited with, swung widest for a run into straight, responded well inside final 300M and hit the front 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 自第九檔出閘，居最後數位之內，留力候上。入直路時移出最外疊取位。最後三百米對催策反應良佳。一百米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 3 raced just behind leaders throughout, fought hard to stay in contention from 300M, couldn't accelerate enough final 150M and made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，沿途居領先馬匹稍後位置。自三百米處起力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米加速力不足，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, moved up to challenge 400M, badly crowded between rivals 150M before fading away over concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處上前展開挑戰。一百五十米處在馬匹之間嚴重受擠迫。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 500m out, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。五百米處受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Away on terms, moved up to be tracking the pace on outside, kept up the chase on leader turning home, fought hard but was held by first two late stage. Hung on for 3rd just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊。入直路時持續追趕領放馬，但末段未能追上頭兩名馬匹。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Ended up racing in midfield along the 3-path, soon left behind on straightening and finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to show sufficient pace to go forward as instructed due to the ""Soft"" track conditions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時瞬即被拋離，大敗而回。（騎師表示，由於「軟地」的場地狀況，坐騎未能展現足夠前速以如指示般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and raced upsides leader, weakened final 200m.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，追逼領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Slightly slow out, well there early stages before drifting back to 5th passing the 1000M, became 6th some 3L back rounding home bend, given reminders 600M out but had nothing to give in straight and checked 180M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，早段居好位。跑過一千米處時墮居第五位。轉直路彎時居第六位，落後約三個馬位。六百米處受鞭策。直路上再無餘力。一百八十米處勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Ridden along from a wide barrier, soon drifted backward to 3-wide with cover in midfield, commenced move entering home straight, ran on dourly under pressure to claim 2nd inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘後受催策，瞬即墮後居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。進入直路時開始上前。最後一百米在催策下力拼，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Started well and across from wide draw to track leading pair, moved smoothly to front 200m out, winner too strong final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入跟隨領先兩駒。走勢暢順，二百米處取得領先。最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (4W2W2W) Jumped well from gate 10, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(4W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。轉入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, stayed on for clear second but never quite able to challenge winner.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。保持走勢，跑獲亞軍，帶離餘駒，但從未能真正挑戰頭馬。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Ridden forward from wide stall, tracked leading pair, loomed up to lead 200m out, ran on well to line but headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處上前領放。保持佳勢至終點，但接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled nicely, led all the way to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 在力策下取得領先。走勢良佳。其後直領到底，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, some headway 500m out, unable to sustain in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處略為追前。直路上無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Commenced well, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 500M, no clear run early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。趨近五百米處時向外移出。直路早段未能望空。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, joined leader 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。六百米處追上領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed forward to be racing in 2nd, fought on one paced in the straight before weakening out of contention final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 受催策上前，居第二位。直路上保持同速。最後一百米轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Prominent, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, stayed on well and in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide with cover, 5 to 6 lengths back, very wide turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(5W3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，落後五至六個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Out in line, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, a length back turning in, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。二百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Away well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out approaching 300M, made contact early in straight, kept on well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。趨近三百米處時向外移出。直路早段與對手互相觸碰。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, 4 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly, won by 3/4L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段衝刺強勁，以四分三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, closed off well for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺良佳，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W2W3W) Raced in touch, forward move turning into home straight, stayed on well to lead 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時上前。保持佳勢，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced towards rear on the outside, slightly improved on turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為推進。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 300m out, stayed on but crossed by runner-up 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持走勢，但五十米處被亞軍馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, raced very keenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。十分搶口。對催策反應一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Raced against inside rail throughout, tracked leader, quickened to lead over 200m out, headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 沿途走內欄，跟隨領放馬。二百米處加速，取得領先。接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W2W2W) Inconvenienced at start, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6-1/2L back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, made good progress thereafter to make frame. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W2W2W) 起步時受妨礙，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空。其後追前甚多，取得第四名。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Showed good speed to lead, headed 600m out, remained prominent, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;展現甚快前速領放。六百米處被超越，仍居前列。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled strongly until 250M, slightly weakened.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢強勁直至二百五十米處。略為轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped well and showed good speed to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，展現甚快前速領放。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 9, raced prominently on the inside early, allowed rival to cross near 750M, sat right behind the leader on turn, kept on well in straight but always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，早段居前列，走內疊。接近七百五十米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎緊隨領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，但一直以些微距離落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。以勁勢追前，一百五十米處取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Settled just worse than midfield in 8th mainly about 5L off the pace, gained closer to 3L 7th into straight but did not find much room most of the way, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 大多居中間稍後的第八位，落後領放馬約五個馬位。入直路時追近至第七位，落後三個馬位，但直路上大部分途程空位不足。未能進一步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W2W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, weakened over the final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W2W) 居前列，走勢一般。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway final bend to chase leaders, sustained headway to challenge 300m out, stayed on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前，追趕領先馬匹。三百米處持續追前以展開挑戰。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to challenge 200m out, share of lead and every chance 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處受催策展開挑戰。一百米處並排領先，一度甚具爭勝機會，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls and crowded shortly after start, in rear, pushed along 500m out, outpaced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，其後不久受擠迫，居後列。五百米處受推策。末段被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after sluggish start, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，其後居後列。五百五十米處受催策。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Towards rear, under pressure turning into home straight, soon no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列。轉入直路時受催策，瞬即毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Close up early before dropping to midfield when given some nudging 950M out, one-paced when hampered 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。其後於九百五十米處受催策，墮居中間位置。二百米處受阻礙，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched back to rail and headway 200m out, stayed on, clear of remainder.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。二百米處移回內欄，上前。保持走勢。拋離其他馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Wide in mid-field, ridden along to hold position throughout, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。沿途受催策以保持位置。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Began well from gate 10, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, carried wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight, not enough room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時被帶出更外疊。直路上保持同速。接近終點時空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled okay, briefly held up at the top of the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走勢不俗。直路初一度受困。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, raced slightly better than midfield on the stands' side, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，靠近外欄競跑。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened and gave ground in the Straight. (Unacceptable performance)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱及墮退。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, raced better than midfield, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外欄第三疊。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, held up in the Straight, closed off nicely once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上受困。望空後衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began awkwardly, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Settled midfield, raced very wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走大外疊。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; A fraction slow away from the stalls, ridden along to be two off the outside fence just behind the speed, off the bit from the 500m and dropped away thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘稍慢，受催策，居領放馬稍後位置，走外欄第三疊。自五百米處起受催策，其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began well from gate 14, raced behind midfield on the stands' rail, made some progress final 400M to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;自第十四檔出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走外欄。最後四百米略為追前，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Settled midfield, raced very wide from 600M, limited response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置。自六百米處起走大外疊。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Jumped cleanly, sat on pace, kept on same pace early in straight, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘俐落，居前列，直路早段保持同速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled midfield, trapped wide throughout, crowded near the 750M, unable to sustain his run final 200M (See Incident Report).
Lame in left front leg.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊。接近七百五十米處時受擠迫。最後二百米後勁不繼。（見競賽事件報告。）
左前腿不良於行。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, took the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Started fast but unable to hold position, checked and back into mid-field halfway, one paced under pressure, checked briefly 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，但未能保持位置。半程時勒避，墮居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。二百米處一度勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, similar position on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, closed off nicely until checked at the 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。衝刺良佳，五十米處勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以佳勢追前，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, made contact near 1000M and 850M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。接近一千米處及八百五十米處時兩度被對手觸碰。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, checked near the 150M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。接近一百五十米處時勒避。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W4W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Raced wide from high draw, improved to track pace before halfway, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘，走外疊。半程前推進上前以跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W4W) Rear of mid-field, taken wide and forward move turning into home straight, sustained run to lead 150m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時移出外疊及上前。持續上前，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W3W3W) Settled behind midfield early before moving closer to leaders down the back straight, in 5th spot making home turn, showed plenty of dash from 300M, powered away final stages to win stylishly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W3W3W) 早段居中間之後位置，對面直路上追近領先馬匹。轉直路彎時居第五位。自三百米處起追前甚多。末段衝刺強勁，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move 500M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 stayed close enough to early pace before settling back in midfield along the inside, held up for clear running making the home turn, crowded for room near 200M and not able to be ridden out to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，早段居接近領放馬的位置，其後留居中間位置，走內疊。轉直路彎時受困而未能望空。接近二百米處時受擠迫，未能被全力催策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped awkward but soon in first few settling over 2L back in 4th 2-wide, came under pressure from 500M out swinging wide into straight, ran on steadily under pressure to hold every only to be outsprinted late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，但瞬即進佔前列第四位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。自五百米處起受催策，入直路時移出外疊。在催策下保持穩勢，已獲機會盡展所長，末段僅被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, held up making the Home Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉直路彎時受困。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W3W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, made some progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W3W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路上略為追前，取得第四名，但未能對前列馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Fast into stride, chased leader on settling, in a good place to pounce but couldn't find the kick under 135lb, just battled home for minor placing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，追趕領放馬。居於有利爭勝的位置，但在負一百三十五磅下未能增速。末段力拼，僅保住季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well from the widest barrier before taking back to share 7th 3-wide after the first 300M, drifted some 6L back to 9th 1200M out, fought on steadily under pressure inside final 300M to claim 4th 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，過了首三百米後留後，並居第七位，走第三疊。千二米處墮居第九位，落後約六個馬位。最後三百米在催策下持續力拼。五十米處進佔第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, blocked off when trying to switch 500m out, didn't get best of runs in home straight when trying to improve.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處在嘗試轉換跑線之際受困。直路上嘗試推進上前，但取位不太暢順。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to join the leader on first bend, chased within 2L of pace in back straight, similar turning for home when unable to quicken to challenge and swamped inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，在首個彎位追上領放馬。對面直路上落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置，未能加速以展開挑戰。最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W6W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide in midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, took the lead 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W7W) Settled in rear of mid-field, twice hampered 450m out to 350m out when trying to improve out wide, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W7W) 居中間之後位置。四百五十米處至三百五十米處之間嘗試在外疊推進時兩度受阻礙。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) From wide draw taken back to last, switched to 3-wide from halfway and made headway from 700M, wide into straight before staying on for 2nd. No match for runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。自半程起移出第三疊，自七百米處起追前。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，取得亞軍，但未能與遙遙領先的頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, headway up rail early in home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列，直路早段沿欄追前，末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持走勢，但未能進一步威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢良佳。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W5W) From wide draw eased back to race in a rearward position, driven wide into the home straight, ran on steadily but was always held by first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 自外檔出閘，收慢留後，居後列。入直路時在催策下走外疊。走勢平穩，但一直落後頭四名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W5W) Was average to begin and angled across to the rear, given a patient ride 10Ls off the good speed, widest into the straight with stacks of ground to make up, made strong late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W5W) 出閘普通，切入內疊，居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬十個馬位，未受催策。入直路時走最外疊，落後頗遠。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Not far off from leaders early stages before dropping back to race in midfield on settling, bustled along 550M but failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段落後領先馬匹不遠，其後墮居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策，但直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, rail position in rear, driven along 550m out, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，居後列，走內欄。五百五十米處受催策，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden after moderate start and checked on heels twice when travelling keenly in early stages, shared 6th 2-wide over 4L back rounding home bend, weakened under pressure approaching home turn.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步普通，其後受催策，早段搶口之際兩度勒避他駒後蹄。轉直路彎時並居第六位，落後逾四個馬位，走第二疊。趨近直路彎時受催策，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along 550m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百五十米處受推策。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, slightly improved along the rail on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為推進。直路初對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began fairly, settled in rear of midfield on rail in 4L 6th or 5th, did not find much room behind runners on rail early in straight, kept on to the line in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後第五或第六位，落後四個馬位，走內欄。直路早段在馬匹之後空位不足，走內欄。保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, failed to respond when asked, weakened (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置。對催策毫無反應。末段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W1W) Tracked pace, struggled to maintain position from 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, dropped to rear middle stages, struggling in home straight, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。中段墮居後列。直路上掙扎上前，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, showed good speed to lead, soon joined by rivals top of home straight, headed by runner-up 200m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，展現甚快前速領放。直路初瞬即被對手追上。二百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, raced prominently, briefly checked 500m out, twice bumped 350m out to 200m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居前列。五百米處一度勒避。三百五十米處至二百米處之間兩度被碰撞。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well in straight, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。中段輕鬆領放。入直路時領先一又四分一馬位。直路上保持佳勢，末段力拒對手的挑戰險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W3W) Tracked leaders, effort 300m out, led 150m out, in control final 100m and won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。一百五十米處取得領先。最後一百米控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Reserved behind midfield early stages, shuffled back to the rear entering home turn, failed to run on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段留居中間之後位置。進入直路彎時墮居後列。最後四百米未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped at start, unable to shift near the rail until taken back to rear 2-wide approaching the winning post the first time, remained towards rear to straight, tightened badly inside the 150M, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，未能移近內欄。首次趨近終點時留居後列，走第二疊。直路前仍居後列。最後一百五十米嚴重受緊迫。末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Towards rear most of the way, ran on past well-beaten horses inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 大部分途程居後列。最後二百米上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back mid-race, pushed along widest into home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W1W2W) 居後列，留力待上。中段墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, keen early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力待上。早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, followed runner-up through 300m out, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled near last in the early stages before moving to midfield halfway, 4Ls off leader top of straight but lacked a strong finishing effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段居接近包尾位置，半程時進佔中間位置。直路初落後領放馬四個馬位，但衝刺欠勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away settling in midfield mainly in 7th on rail, saved ground on the inside turning for home, ran on well under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，大多居中間第七位，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 350M, made good progress in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自三百五十米處起走第二疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Given a waiting ride in a position towards the rear, had 7Ls to make up on leader leaving the bend, ran on well under pressure and swept past long time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。跑離直路彎時仍落後領放馬七個馬位。在催策下以佳勢上前，接近終點時超越大部分途程帶頭的領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, keen early stages, driven 400m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。早段搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Given a waiting ride in a position near the rear, lacked a finishing effort passing 400M. Never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列，留力候上。跑過四百米處時衝刺乏力。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, made some progress after passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百米處後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Behind midfield early stages but got shuffled back to the rear making the home turn, worked home just fairly in the straight. (Jockey - no explanation for the performance / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 早段居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時墮居後列。直路上走勢僅屬一般。（騎師未能就坐騎的表現提供任何解釋。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W5W) From draw 11 dropped back to race near last 8Ls off leader in a fast run race, switched wide 450M to commence his run, stayed on well enough to take 3rd without threatening first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W3W5W) 自第十一檔出閘後墮居接近包尾位置，在快步速下落後領放馬八個馬位。四百五十米處移出外疊以開始上前。末段保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover early stages, settled with cover middle stages, forced to steady 450m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。中段取得遮擋。四百五十米處被迫收慢，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled just over 3L back in 5th on rail, obtained a clear run 200M out, ran on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居第五位，落後稍逾三個馬位，走內欄。二百米處望空。在催策下上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, still 8 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。入直路時仍落後八個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W1W2W) Tracked leader along the inside, responded well to be challenging for the lead from 300M, kept battling to the line final stages but was always held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走內疊。自三百米處起對催策反應良佳，爭奪領先。末段持續力拼至終點，但一直未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Crowded and bumped leaving stalls, ridden along from stalls to lead, kicked 550m out, gave ground final 300m, forced to steady 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生碰撞，其後受催策，領放。五百五十米處加速。最後三百米墮退。二百米處被迫收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield, moved forward to be closer to leaders back straight, loomed up top of the straight, fought hard but only maintained the position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。對面直路上上前，追近領先馬匹。直路初上前。力拼，但僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 650M, 2 lengths back turning in, made good progress early in straight, bumped near 150M, peaked on run 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。自六百五十米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路初追前甚多。接近一百五十米處時被碰撞。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Bumped at the start, settled ahead of midfield about 3Ls off the pace, moved up to 3rd early straight, fought hard but couldn't close off as well as the leaders final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。直路早段追前至第三位。末段力拼，但最後二百米的衝刺不及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Tracked leaders against rail, travelled smoothly to 400m out, shifted left early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百米處前走勢暢順。直路初向外斜跑。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leaders, quickened 400m out to lead 250m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處加速，二百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Away well, chased leader in a strongly run race, drove hard passing 300M and edged ahead last stride. Won in class record time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，追趕領放馬，賽事步速甚快。跑過三百米處時受力策。最後一步取得領先。以破班次紀錄時間勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W5W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Raced in rear after crowded at start, still in last pair top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 起步後受擠迫，居後列。直路初仍居最後兩位之內，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on rail, 2 wide turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually close home.
(Sustained a laceration to the left front cannon.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a laceration to the left front cannon.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走第二疊。直路初追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。
（左前腿管骨部位割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W6W) Sluggish start, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but no further impression close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 自大外檔起步緩慢，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但接近終點時再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Gradually settled towards rear racing 3-wide with cover down back straight, swung one of the widest turning in for home, ran on dourly under pressure to claim victory close to post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 對面直路上逐漸居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Settled down in midfield along the 2-path, driven wide into straight, couldn't sustain run passing 250M and weakened. (Jockey - horse lay out in the home straight. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時受催策，走外疊。跑過二百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在直路上外閃。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Soon taken across from a poor draw for rails run in midfield in 7th some 4L off the pace, gained slightly closer to 6th in back straight, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即切入內欄取位，居中間第七位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。對面直路上略為追近至第六位。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。以穩勢上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 200m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處向外移出取位。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced in 2nd , 2 wide, 3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W1W) Made contact at start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, keen under restraint, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。在約束下搶口。直路初受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。走勢良佳，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Followed leader to get across, chased leader, ridden top of home straight, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬以切入，追趕領放馬。直路初受催策。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well from the 2 draw, gained outright lead passing the winning post the first time and rails run shortly after, travelled keenly from the 1100M in back straight, maintained narrow advantage around home bend, swamped.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，首次跑過終點時單騎領放，其後不久走內欄。自對面直路千一米處起搶口。轉直路彎時以短距離領先，其後被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W2W) Missed the start and lost a considerable amount of ground, at the tail of the field early then made rapid headway from 1100M to join leader, no match for winner's acceleration from 400M but fought on steadily to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W2W) 漏閘，失地甚多。早段居馬群尾列，自千一米處起快速上前，追上領放馬。自四百米處起加速力不及頭馬，但持續力拼，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, good headway around field to lead over 200m out, challenged 100m out, ran on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。其後繞過馬群，追前甚多。二百米處取得領先。一百米處受挑戰。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W1W) Slowly away, outpaced in rear, never competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，未能跟上步速。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Began only fairly, raced at rear, 10 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。入直路時落後十個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide early, began to improve from the 900M, closed off strongly, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W4W) 早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自九百米處起開始推進。衝刺強勁，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (4W3W2W4W) Settled towards rear, came under pressure rounding home bend, ran on well in straight to grab 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(4W3W2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時受催策。直路上走勢良佳，末段跑獲第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Ridden along at the back after moderate start, trailed the field and wide into straight, ran on strongly down the centre of the track to snatch 3rd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 出閘普通，居後列，受催策。入直路時尾隨馬群，走外疊。在跑道中央走勢強勁，最後數步跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, ridden along 400m out to chase leader, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover throughout, improved to press leader 700m out, pressed on 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 沿途在沒有遮擋下走外疊。七百米處推進以追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, pushed along to chase leader top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。直路初受推策，追趕領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W3W) Tracked leaders, pushed along 450m out to chase leaders, unable to match winner but stayed on steadily, lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。未能追上頭馬，但保持穩勢。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away in line, stayed close enough to leaders, moved up to 2nd top of straight, responded well to take lead near 200M but couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，保持落後領先馬匹不遠。直路初上前進佔第二位。對催策反應良佳，接近二百米處時取得領先，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From wide draw crossed to race in a 2-wide spot just off leaders, responded well leaving the bend to be challenging for the lead mid-straight, hard driven final 200M and only went down by a neck . Game in defeat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，切入第二疊，緊隨領先馬匹。離開直路彎時對催策反應良佳。直路中段爭奪領先。最後二百米受力策，在力拼下僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Waited with in rear, raced keenly throughout, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not far off the leaders early stages, checked 750M losing ground, had 3-4Ls to make up 400M, lacked a finishing kick and was safely held in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段落後領先馬匹不遠。七百五十米處勒避，失地。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺乏力，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in worse than midfield and waited with, obtained a run just over 200M out and quickened well to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，留力候上。就在過了二百米處後取得空位上前。以佳勢加速，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 1 raced behind midfield towards the outside of the group, ran on one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘後居中間之後位置，靠近馬群外側競跑。最後四百米保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along towards centre of course 400m out, bumped 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處發生碰撞。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 100m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。一百米處一度受阻礙，掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) In 4th spot always close enough to leaders, moved up to challenge for the lead passing 300M, no match for winner's pace final 200M. Finished clear 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 居第四位，沿途緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時上前爭奪領先。最後二百米加速力不及頭馬。跑獲亞軍，拋離餘駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Three wide in rear, shuffled back top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路初墮後。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along widest into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。衝刺強勁，一百米處帶頭，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W4W) Raced in midfield, raced keenly in the middle stages, wide into straight then picked up strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W4W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。入直路時走外疊。其後加速強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, pushed along to chase leaders on bend, not best of runs 300m out to 100m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策以追趕領先馬匹。三百米處至一百米處之間取位不太暢順。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Moved up to race just outside the lead, challenged the leader seriously in the home straight but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 上前居領放馬外側。直路上對領放馬展開真正挑戰，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Switched off to last on jumping from a wide draw, 8Ls off the pace on settling, taken widest passing 400M, closed off well down outside to finish 8th, not beaten far by the placegetters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。跑過四百米處時移出最外疊。末段在外疊衝刺良佳，取得第八名，落後入位馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W4W) Obtained a midfield spot along the 3-path, given a patient ride until nearing 400M, closed off strongly in the straight to get up last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。留力候上直至接近四百米處。直路上衝刺強勁，最後一步取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Close up early before taken back to midfield in 6th first turn, in similar position into home straight, ran on down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。首個彎位留居中間第六位。入直路時居相若位置。沿跑道中央上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Guided to race along the fence in midfield, in a similar spot turning home, finished off moderately under a big weight but couldn't be ridden out when racing tight over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置。在負重磅下衝刺普通，但末段在緊迫競跑之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Midfield throughout, kept on steadily without quickening in straight, inconvenienced about 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 沿途居中間位置。直路上保持穩勢，未能加速。約一百米處受妨礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 500m out, lacked pace to challenge, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, tight of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百五十米處。最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，贏出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Raced keenly early stages when being restrained to obtain a position behind midfield, had over 5Ls to make up 400M, came with a strong finish and drove hard late stages to just get the verdict.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 早段搶口，在約束下居中間之後位置。四百米處落後逾五個馬位。末段以勁勢衝刺，在力策下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Bumped at the start, held up towards the rear 6-7Ls off the pace, had some work to do 400M, responded well when asked but was denied clear running from 100M to the finish. Inconclusive run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居後列，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。四百米處仍落後甚遠。對催策反應良佳，但自一百米處起未能望空至終點。未能全力發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from the one draw but soon dropped to last few on rail, commenced run upon straightening and ran on well to be nearest finish.
(Sustained an abrasion to left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，但瞬即墮居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時開始發力，以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。
（左後腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped on terms, settled down midfield 3-4Ls off the pace, kept up the chase on leaders final 300M but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後領放馬三至四個馬位。最後三百米保持追趕領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W3W) From draw 12 given a waiting ride, raced keenly near last in a 3-wide position without cover, brought widest for home before making some progress to finish midfield.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留力候上。居接近包尾位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋，搶口。直路上移出最外疊，其後略為追前，居中間位置過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained in mid-division along the fence, close enough to leaders passing 300M, did best work late and was nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。跑過三百米處時落後領先馬匹不遠。末段表現最佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke awkwardly and settled 2nd last after crowded at the start, accelerated only until the last 50m, beaten less than 3L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後受擠迫，居尾二位置。僅在最後五十米始能加速。所負不足三個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden top of home straight to chase leader, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初受催策以追趕領放馬。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made contact early in straight, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初發生觸碰。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Pressed forward, emerged as leader 850M setting good pace to straight, headed by winner near 250M, faded late to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 受催策上前，八百五十米處取得領先。直路前以中等步速領放。接近二百五十米處時被頭馬超越，末段力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W) Up with leaders early stages before settling down in a trailing position just off the pace, kept on one paced under top weight on straightening, always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W) 早段跟上領先馬匹，其後居領放馬稍後有遮擋的位置。入直路時在負頂磅下保持同速，一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped well from gate 12, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded at start, made running, race keenly throughout, headed by winner 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，帶頭競跑。沿途搶口。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Very wide in prominent 4th in early stages, within striking distance for place chance turning into straight only to be denied a placing final stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 早段居前列第四位，走大外疊。入直路時有機會爭入位置，僅最後數步未能入位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Always thereabouts settling one-out-one-back in 3rd or 4th in back straight, commenced move 3-wide home bend hitting the front under pressure inside the 300m, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 沿途居啣接位置。對面直路上居第三或第四位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎開始發力，走第三疊。三百米處在催策下取得領先。末段保持佳勢掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled mainly in midfield, commenced move on rail rounding home bend, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 大多居中間位置。轉直路彎時開始沿欄上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Gradually taken back from a wide barrier to be last with rails run 750M out, improved steadily closer home bend reaching 5L 10th into straight, ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留後。七百五十米處居包尾位置，走內欄。直路彎穩步上前追近，入直路時進佔第十位，落後五個馬位。末段以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Box seat, switched for clear run 400m out, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, tired closing stages and just held fourth.
