runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 居包廂位置。四百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。末段呈現疲態，僅能保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (5W3W3W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, raced wide and without cover in the early stages, raced keenly near 800M, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(5W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。早段走外疊，沒有遮擋。接近八百米處時搶口。衝刺強勁，跑獲第二名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W4W) Made contact shortly after start, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths back in the early stages, 3 wide after passing 700M, slightly improved on turn, very wide into straight, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，走第二疊。早段落後四個馬位。跑過七百米處後走第三疊。直路彎略為追前。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Tracked leader, ridden along 500m out to chase leader, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。五百米受催策，追趕領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Went forward as expected and led steadily to the home straight, kept to the task from 300M, lost lead nearing 150M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘後如預期般上前。以平穩步速領放至直路。自三百米處起保持走勢。接近一百五十米處時被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Set strong pace, pressed in front, headed top of home straight, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 以快步速領放，在領放下受追迫。直路初被超越。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, two lengths clear 600m out, three lengths clear into home straight, weakened quickly and headed by winner 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。六百米處帶離兩個馬位。入直路時帶離三個馬位。迅速轉弱。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made all, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 領放。二百米處加速帶離對手兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped well, raced prominently on the middle track, peaked on run approaching 350M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居前列，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百五十米處時未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Soon took up running on the rail setting a sound pace, angled out on straightening and hung on well under pressure in front until swamped final few strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，以快步速領放，走內欄。入直路時向外移出。在領放下受催策時保持佳勢，直至最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W) Jumped well, gradually taken back to 5th some 3L back 800M out, renewed effort from wide into home straight, ran on steadily under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速。八百米處逐漸留居第五位，落後約三個馬位。入直路時重新發力，走外疊。最後二百米在催策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride behind mid-division, brought wide to challenge passing 400M before staying on steadily for modest 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 早段未受催策，居中間之後位置，留力候上。跑過四百米處時移出外疊以展開挑戰。其後保持穩勢，取得第五名，表現一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked on run near 100M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初追前頗多。接近一百米處時未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W6W) Wide in mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W6W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初難以保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Mid-field, smooth headway into contention 300m out, quickened to lead 200m out and soon in control, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處以暢順走勢上前，躋身爭勝行列。二百米處加速以取得領先，瞬即控制大局，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began quickly but held up on rail behind leader, became 3rd in a similar position early in back straight, kept on one pace without quickening in home straight and faded inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，留居領放馬之後，走內欄。對面直路早段居相若第三位。直路上保持同速，未能加速。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (6W1W1W) Ridden to slender lead from a wide barrier, obtained rails run over 600M out, led until headed 200M out and swamped for a placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(6W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策，領先短距離。六百米處移入內欄。保持領先，二百米處被超越。末段再被後上馬匹超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Prominent early, dropped to 3L back in 5th 600M out, produced late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列。六百米處墮居第五位，落後三個馬位。最後一百米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W2W) Across to settle in mid-field, switched to secure clear run 200m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W2W) 切入居中間位置，二百米處轉換跑線以望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, got across to track leaders, followed winner through 300m out, stayed on well but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，切入內疊以跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Soon took up running obtaining rails run early in back straight, led the field until joined over 250m out, fought on well under pressure but found fast-finishing winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭。對面直路早段移入內欄。保持領先，二百五十米處被追上。在催策下以佳勢力拼，但未能抗衡衝刺凌厲的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden on bend to chase leaders, travelled smoothly for clear run top of home straight, narrow lead 150m out, no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。走勢暢順，直路初望空。一百五十米處以短距離領先。末段不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead 850M, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。八百五十米處取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢。末段力拒對手的挑戰險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Ridden along from widest draw to get across, headed top of home straight, stuck to task, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自最外檔出閘後受催策，切入內疊。直路初被超越。持續力拼。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Made running, ridden top of home straight, headed 300m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, bumped near 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近二百米處時被碰撞，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider on bend, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Obtained a midfield position along the fence, raced keenly when pace steadied after 800M, lacked a finishing response in the straight and never able to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。過了八百米處後在步速減慢時搶口。直路上在催策下衝刺乏力。從未能挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Ran out of room and bumped after leaving the stalls, went back to be 2nd last soon after, swung for home to be the widest, produced some minor progress in the final stages, crying out for a longer trip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘後空位不足及發生碰撞，其後迅即墮居尾二位置。入直路時移出最外疊。末段略為追前。適合增程角逐。
